headline: Texas Instruments (TXN) Lands GE Appliances Role In Next Connected Devices
summary: GE Appliances has announced plans to integrate Texas Instruments semiconductors into its next generation of connected appliances manufactured in the U.S. Texas Instruments will supply microcontrollers and connectivity solutions that sit at the core of GE Appliances' smart home product lineup. The collaboration focuses on U.S. based production and reflects growing demand for reliable IoT hardware in large scale consumer products.
